And he's not that big a boy, either. Kinda wimpy, even. Hair like a mop.

[[Shooty McShooterson|03]]

You have a spirited discussion on monetary policy. The guy is kind, but altogether boring.

THY GAME IS OVER

<<display "Inventory">>

Well, good on you. He falls over in a crupled, rosy mist. The room rings, then all is quiet.

You've really screwed the pooch this time.

[[Try again?|Endgame]]

<<display "Inventory">>

You sure about that? This guy probably has a family. Kids. Friends.

[[Violence!|02]]
<> This kitten, maybe? [[That kitten doesn't have a gun.|07]]

<<display "Inventory">>

Dear God. Videogames have ruined you.

[[Don't Care.|08]]

<<display "Inventory">>

Come on. You don't really want to do this!

[[Sure do. I even brought hollow points!|05]]

<<display "Inventory">>

I think he's a vegetarian, too.

[[Sucks to be him.|04]]

<<display "Inventory">>

What about the appeal to subtlety?

[[VIIII!|09]]
<> Please. I'm begging you. Look! Here's a puppy! Isn't he cute? Tons better than blowing this guy's head off. [[Fuck Puppies. Shoot dudes!|06]]

You mention Ron Paul and The Wizard of Oz and feel quite witty. The man does not respond. He cannot. He is dead.

You reflect on this, briefly, in the silence.
